question: 2026年华东区域每月净销售额
sql: WITH rr AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_amount) refund_amount FROM refund WHERE refund_status='COMPLETED' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) month_no,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount)-COALESCE(SUM(rr.refund_amount),0) net_sales FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN region g ON g.region_id=c.region_id JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' AND g.region_code='EAST' AND o.order_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY month_no

question: 客户净销售额排名前10
sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT o.customer_id,o.order_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) gross_sales FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' GROUP BY o.customer_id,o.order_id), rr AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_amount) refund_amount FROM refund WHERE refund_status='COMPLETED' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT c.customer_name,SUM(s.gross_sales-COALESCE(rr.refund_amount,0)) net_sales FROM sales s JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.order_id=s.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

question: 2026年各区域销售额
sql: SELECT g.region_name,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) gross_sales FROM region g JOIN customer c ON c.region_id=g.region_id JOIN sales_order o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' AND o.order_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY g.region_name ORDER BY gross_sales DESC
